messages:
sam (infra-planning): FYI vendor Zenith just pushed a late notice on 10 H100s for the EU hub. They show ETA shift +8 days.
maria (procurement): Ugh, which PO? Can we reassign from APAC buffer?
vendor-zenith: Apologies — customs reclassification in FRA triggered a hold. We can split the shipment 6 sea / 4 air and expedite the 4 for an added fee.
li (ops): What is the expedite surcharge? need numbers to decide vs reprovisioning.
maria (procurement): Zenith quoted +$18,250 for air expedite (total). Sea keep is free but +8 days. We also have 3 RMAs finishing QC that free 2 units next week.
sam (infra-planning): If we do air, do we get insurance + AWB details? Also need ETA post-clearance.
vendor-zenith: Insurance is covered for the expedite. AWB for the expedite group (will send once manifested): ```AWB: 1Z999AA10123456784``` ETA after clearance: 3 business days.
anna (logistics): RMA lane question — can the 2 soon-to-be-refurb units be routed straight to EU temp-pool to cover shortfall? photos already uploaded.
maria (procurement): We can route RMA-refurb to temp-pool but refurbishment handling = $500/unit + 1 day processing.
li (ops): Quick option matrix: A) Accept 4-air expedite + 2 RMA-refurb into pool => +$18.25k + $1k refurb = $19.25k cost, availability in ~3 days. B) Reassign 6 units from APAC buffer => ~8 days transit and routing ops, lower direct cost but SLA miss risk.
sam (infra-planning): For customer SLAs we need at least 6 units in-region within 5 days. Option A meets timeline. Maria can you approve up to $20k expedite?
maria (procurement): Approved up to $20,000. Finance will need invoice + GL codes. @vendor-zenith please confirm final expedite invoice and ship-by timestamp.
vendor-zenith: Confirmed. We'll manifest and ship the 4 expedited units today; ship-by timestamp: 1714632170. Final expedite fee = $18,250 USD. We'll attach AWB, customs docs, and RMA refs to the invoice.
procurement-bot: PO 43721 updated: expedite line added, status = awaiting vendor invoice. :white_check_mark:
sam (infra-planning): Excellent. li / anna I’ll open the routing ticket and tag the EU depot for intake + customs broker notice.
li (ops): Opening ticket now, will post depot ETA once AWB scans land. :eyes:
anna (logistics): I'll prep the temp-pool intake slot and photo checklist for the RMA-refurb units.
sam (infra-planning): Thanks team — keep updates short here. If vendor posts AWB scan ping this thread. :thumbsup:
